comparison_modes.matched_model_ablation: Hold foundation model, task, tools, budgets, runtime environment and grader fixed; isolate one architecture or assurance component.
comparison_modes.best_available_product: Compare each eligible product in its strongest documented supported configuration; record model, tools, permissions, infrastructure, budget and all configuration differences.

eligibility.candidate: The product/workflow can plausibly perform this profile after an adapter and exact capability verification.
eligibility.conditional: A product or partner environment may qualify, but access, deployment, feature maturity or task capability must be confirmed before inclusion.
eligibility.reference_only: Useful industry/physical reference case, but not a directly comparable agent workflow.
eligibility.not_eligible: Not a valid comparison arm for this profile under the current evidence snapshot.

arms.rationale: Qualified maintainer workflow can execute the same source-view tasks; record role/experience and human minutes.
Foundry is an agent development/evaluation platform, not itself a complete code-repair agent; pin the actual coding agent, model, tools and Foundry configuration.
AgentCore can host/govern/evaluate an agent; pair it with a pinned coding model, repository tools and equivalent permissions.
Successor portfolio may provide middleware, evaluation and harness execution; confirm release access, supported tools and exact maturity; exclude deprecated NeMo Agent Toolkit.
A model endpoint is not a complete coding workflow; specify the agent harness, repository tools, policy and evidence export.
Pin model, harness, tool versions, sandbox, system prompts, context and cost.
Use CEB's existing tasks and independent graders; run component ablations plus full composition.
Company-level semiconductor/private-cloud portfolio is not a directly comparable repository coding agent.
Industrial engineering reference only; no public, reproducible agent workflow identified for matched software engineering tasks.

workload_profiles.title: Engineering change impact and lifecycle evidence applicability

arms.rationale: Use blinded multi-reviewer adjudication and retain disagreement.
Use an auditable dependency or MBSE/PLM workflow with identical source package; record manual configuration and analyst effort.

arms.system: Microsoft Foundry agent plus named engineering system
arms.rationale: Foundry is an agent platform, not a PLM/MBSE evidence authority; name the actual engineering product, connector coverage and export semantics.

arms.system: AWS AgentCore agent plus named engineering system
arms.rationale: AgentCore supplies agent runtime/evaluation/policy capabilities; the engineering source-of-truth and evidence semantics must be separately named.

arms.system: NVIDIA NeMo workflow plus named engineering system
arms.rationale: Evaluate only if a supported agent workflow can consume the exact design/evidence artifacts; do not conflate simulation with lifecycle authority.

arms.system: Google model/API agent plus named engineering system
arms.rationale: Model endpoint alone is ineligible; pin toolchain, source system and evaluator.
Consume #10543 gold corpus and existing subsystem contracts; benchmark proposal/assessment only, no release authority.
Broadcom's infrastructure software and semiconductor portfolio is not itself a publicly documented general design-change applicability workflow.
Relevant industrial reference, but internal design-change datasets and processes are not publicly available for matched evaluation.

arms.system: Siemens Teamcenter 2606 / Teamcenter X AI BOM + MBSE workflow
arms.rationale: Direct PLM/MBSE comparator. Requires exact Teamcenter edition, enabled AI BOM/MBSE features, deployment, model/agent and license pin; vendor documentation only, no measured output.

arms.system: Aras Innovator UCM + Impact Analysis AI Agent v1.0.1
arms.rationale: Priority direct AI change-impact comparator. Requires provisioned UCM tenant, v1.0.1 agent, product structure and historical change order fixture; AI specialists are not independent human adjudicators.

arms.system: PTC Windchill 13.1.2 change impact + configured external trace links
arms.rationale: Direct PLM/change-impact comparator for local and upstream/downstream external objects. Pin modules, remote object types, requirements integration and exact configuration.

arms.system: IBM DOORS Next 7.2 paired with named PLM
arms.rationale: Requirements-to-requirements/development/test traceability adjunct only; not a stand-alone complete PLM or physical-evidence applicability arm.

workload_profiles.title: Cross-stack agent security, authority and actual effect

arms.rationale: Human policy and red-team reviewers assess identical synthetic controls.
Pin the agent framework, identity/policy enforcement components, model, tool access and telemetry; Foundry observability alone is not an effect oracle.
AgentCore has identity, gateway, evaluation and policy/guardrail capabilities; confirm target-region availability and configure identical task permissions.
Confirm available successor components, policy semantics and exact effect enforcement; deprecated toolkit is not a valid new baseline.

arms.system: Google model/API with explicit agent gateway
arms.rationale: Model/API is not an authority system; the gateway, identity, effect enforcement and evidence export must be pinned.
Use a pinned policy gateway/runtime with the same attack/effect fixtures and tool permissions.
Consume #10771 fixtures; measure actual synthetic effects and independent reconstruction, not agent self-report.
No directly comparable agent-security product identified in this scoped comparison.
Internal security operations are not publicly accessible for a matched product comparison.

workload_profiles.title: AI compute, datacentre and grid-interactive operations

arms.rationale: Freeze scheduling, power-cap, cooling and storage policies; retain the actual facility boundary.
Relevant to GPU scheduling/telemetry and accelerator power; require equivalent measured traces and facility instrumentation.
Eligible only where a documented customer-accessible workload/power control is available for the specific task; avoid assuming access to internal fleet control.
Eligible only where a customer-accessible product exposes comparable control and telemetry; name the exact product and permissions.
AWS customer-facing compute APIs are not equivalent to internal facility control; compare only the same controllable boundary.
Potentially comparable for private-cloud resource scheduling/operations, not automatically for facility power, cooling or grid response.
1.7 GW nameplate compute is a company-reported fleet figure; internal control interface, workload data and site telemetry are not publicly available.
Consume #3776's matched benchmark; compare candidate planners through independent schedule/physical-state verifiers.
Use matched task environment and expert-defined constraints; retain intervention time and safety stops.
Pin exact Isaac/Omniverse/robotics stack, robot, simulator and policies; separate simulation results from physical trials.
Partner rollout and supported hardware/access must be confirmed; the reported Apollo kitting result is a company-reported proof of concept, not a general public test arm.
Pin robot, sensors, calibration, firmware, policy and simulator; use held-out task families.
Use existing spatial and trajectory contracts; physical execution remains a separate approved test stage.
General agent runtimes are not robot controllers absent a named, qualified robotics integration.
No directly comparable general robotics policy/control product identified in this profile.
Manufacturing and aerospace operations are relevant industrial targets, but internal task data and robot control are not publicly accessible.

rules: Do not compare systems that do not have equivalent task access or control authority.
Vendor-reported product claims are context, not matched benchmark scores.
Unavailable product adapters remain explicit; do not silently omit them from eligibility accounting.
Keep company-level and industrial reference cases separate from directly comparable products.
No live physical actuation or production credentials are authorized by this matrix.
